subject: Genetics
title: Speciation
description: A quick, practical guide to Speciation.

hook.text: Apple maggot flies originally fed on hawthorn.

buildup.text: Speciation is how one species becomes two. Geographic or behavioral barriers stop gene flow, and divergence begins.

discovery.text: Apple and hawthorn flies now mate at different times.

twist.text: Ring species show speciation in progress.

climax.text: Species boundaries aren't sharp lines. They're gradients. Speciation is a process, not a moment.

punchline.text: Two species start as one that stops talking.
